title: Sign in as a student and reach the student dashboard
description: This verifies that a student can log in with valid credentials and arrive on the student dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Choose the student user type
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the student dashboard is displayed

title: Validate a reset link and update the password
description: This verifies that a valid reset link opens the reset form, accepts matching passwords, and confirms the password update.
category: Validate reset token and set a new password

steps.description: Navigate to /reset-password with a valid token and email in the URL
Wait for the reset token to be validated
Fill in the new password field with a valid password
Fill in the password confirmation field with the same password
Submit the password update
Verify a password updated confirmation is visible

title: Request a password recovery link
description: This verifies that a user can submit a recovery email and receive the generic confirmation message.

steps.description: Navigate to /forgot-password
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Submit the recovery request
Verify a generic recovery confirmation is visible

title: Reject incorrect login credentials
description: This verifies that login shows the generic invalid credentials message when the user type and credentials do not match.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Choose the student user type
Fill in the email field with invalid credentials
Fill in the password field with invalid credentials
Submit the login form
Verify an invalid credentials message is visible

title: Create a new user account successfully
description: An administrator can create a new user account and see it appear in the users list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Select the administrator user type
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin/users
Open the add user form
Choose a user type
Fill in the first name field with a unique name
Fill in the last name field with a unique surname
Fill in the username part field with a unique username
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Submit the user creation form
Verify the new account appears in the users list

title: Reject an invalid email format during login

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Choose the student user type
Fill in the email field with an invalid email format
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify an email validation error is visible

title: Update the email domain when choosing a user type

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Select the administrator user type
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin/users

Observe the generated email domain

Verify the email domain reflects the selected user type
